indication: research reagent - physiological knockdown of Galpha-i2 in rat ependyma
design_source: Monkkonen 2007 BMC Neurosci 8:26, PMID 17430589, DOI 10.1186/1471-2202-8-26, Methods 'Oligonucleotides'
notes: [hydro_baseline] CRITICAL CHEMISTRY QUALIFIER: this is an UNMODIFIED phosphodiester DNA 18-mer, not a phosphorothioate and not a 2'-modified gapmer. The Methods say 'unmodified 18-mer oligonucleotides' and that 'RNase free, aseptic conditions were maintained until implantation of the cannulas to prevent degradation of unmodified oligonucleotides'. ps_count=0 and backbone_chemistry=full_PO follow directly from that statement. Targets nucleotides 150-167 (N-terminal coding region) of rat Galpha-i2; the authors state the sequence matched no other rat sequence. HPLC-purified, 90-97% purity, dissolved in sterile saline. Sequence transcribed verbatim from the Methods (printed there as 5'-CTT GTC GAT CAT CTT AGA-3'); the source printed it in flat upper case with no chemistry-encoding case, and it is stored that way per the schema's sequence-case rule.

indication: research reagent - sequence-specificity control for the anti-Galpha-i2 AS-ODN
notes: [hydro_baseline] THE CHEMISTRY CONTROL THAT DECIDES THE MECHANISM QUESTION. Same unmodified phosphodiester DNA chemistry, same length, same route, same dose and same base composition as the anti-Galpha-i2 AS-ODN, differing only by eight mismatches; the Methods call it 'a more stringent control, maintaining equal base composition to the antisense molecule but with eight mismatches', and state it matched no rat sequence. Because this molecule produced NO ventricular dilatation in vivo and NO change in ciliary beat frequency in vitro at identical exposure, the AS-ODN effect is attributable to knockdown of the TARGET (Galpha-i2), not to oligonucleotide chemistry. Sequence transcribed verbatim from the Methods, printed there as 5'-TCTGCTGATACTCTTGAA-3' with the eight mismatched positions set off typographically in the original.

indication: research reagent - non-targeting control for the anti-Galpha-i2 AS-ODN
notes: [hydro_baseline] Second, non-base-matched control ODN; same unmodified phosphodiester DNA chemistry, length, route and dose as the AS-ODN. The Methods state the nonsense sequence matched no rat sequence. Used as the ODN control arm in the histology and Galpha-i2 immunohistochemistry figures (Fig 5, Fig 7), where the ependymal cell layer was normal. Sequence transcribed verbatim from the Methods, printed there as 5'-GGG GGA AGT AGG TCT TGG-3'. Note the run of five consecutive G residues: a G-quartet motif is itself a known source of sequence-specific non-antisense effects, which is a reason the base-composition-matched mismatch ODN (CNS589) is the stronger control of the two.
